title: TRACE: Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing for Safer Language Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15365v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can produce harmful content while generating a response. A useful safeguard should not only detect this risk during generation but also intervene while leaving safe responses largely unchanged and provide an auditable record of the internal patterns supporting its decisions. We propose TRACE (Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing), a framework that tracks harmful-response risk during generation, selectively edits token activations, and leaves an auditable trace of its detection and steering decisions. TRACE learns a codebook of recurring activation patterns, with each codebook vector representing a latent concept. At inference time, it assigns each token activation to the nearest codebook vector to obtain the corresponding concept. A gated recurrent unit (GRU) processes the activations and their assigned concept features to predict completed-response harmfulness and a monotone cumulative streaming risk

translated_title: TRACE：面向更安全语言生成的时间性风险评估与概念编辑
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成回复的过程中可能产生有害内容。一个实用的安全防护机制不仅应当能够在生成过程中检测这种风险，还应当能够在进行干预的同时基本保持安全回复不变，并提供支持其决策的内部模式的可审计记录。我们提出了TRACE（时间性风险评估与概念编辑，Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing），这是一个在生成过程中跟踪有害回复风险、选择性地编辑词元激活，并为其检测和引导决策留下可审计踪迹的框架。TRACE学习一个由反复出现的激活模式组成的码本，其中每个码本向量代表一个潜在概念。在推理时，它将每个词元激活分配给最近的码本向量，从而获得对应的概念。门控循环单元（GRU）处理这些激活及其被分配的概念特征，以预测完整回复的有害性以及单调递增的累积流式风险。
tldr: 提出了TRACE框架，通过学习激活模式码本识别潜在概念，并利用GRU在生成过程中实时预测有害风险和单调累积流式风险，同时选择性地编辑词元激活以干预有害内容生成、保持安全回复基本不变，并留下可审计的检测与引导决策记录。
en_tdlr: TRACE is a safety framework that tracks harmful-response risk during generation using a learned codebook of activation patterns and a GRU-based streaming risk predictor, selectively edits token activations to intervene against harmful content while leaving safe responses largely unchanged, and provides an auditable trace of its detection and steering decisions.
